content: Hi everyone. I was hoping to make a small PR with some simple theorems about Hermitian matrices. I have two theorems about the relationship between Hermitian/skew adjoint matrices, and one theorem about matrices that are simultaneously Hermitian and unitary. I am hesitant to add new dependencies to Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Hermitian such as Mathlib.Data.Complex.Basic and Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.UnitaryGroup, and I was wondering how this would usually be approached. Thanks!

I usually use #find_home to locate a good location for my code. I just checked, and there are multiple files in Mathlib which import LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Hermitian and Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.UnitaryGroup so it will likely fit in one of those.

If none of those places seem to fit, then you might be better off making a new file entirely.
